status: exact three-line small-index LTI benchmark; nonlinear and nonstationary extensions remain open

driveModel.scope: first order in amplitude depth m and phase/frequency modulation index beta

responseChain.calibration: F_n=H(omega_n)D(omega_n) is measured independently at all retained lines

invariants.pureClassRule: sign Re(K): positive AM, negative FM

informationLossLedger.record: carrier and both coherent complex sidebands with calibrated F_n
loses: higher modulation orders outside the declared approximation
clock-invariant AM/FM separation without an independent phase convention
modulation class after matched final state

benchmark.heldOutPolicy: fit no response parameters from class labels; use independently known F_n and test every Cartesian combination

closure.exact: coherent three-line tomography separates and reconstructs the declared AM/FM mixture after arbitrary calibrated LTI oscillator and detector folding
closure.noGo: power-only, one-sideband, ringdown-only and sideband-excluding records do not identify modulation class
closure.nextUse: the record bundle is the preregistered nuisance baseline for the G2 long/short-root response demonstrator
closure.boundary: large-index Bessel ladders, nonlinear mixing, time-varying response, clock drift within a record and metastable hysteresis require separate extensions
